Package app

Class ShoppingCart

java.lang.Object
app.ShoppingCart
public class ShoppingCart extends Object
Maintains a store shopper's selected quantities for each salable product. Products are tracked using a stable array of product references, while cart quantities remain separate from the available inventory quantities.

  • Method Details

    • addProduct

      public boolean addProduct(int index)
      Adds one unit of a product to the cart (without adjusting store stock). Only StoreFront coordinates both the inventory and cart changes.
      Parameters:
      index - zero-based product position
      Returns:
      true if a cart quantity was increased

    • removeProduct

      public boolean removeProduct(int index)

      Parameters:
      index - zero-based product position
      Returns:
      true if an item was actually in the cart and removed

    • getQuantity

      public int getQuantity(int index)
      Gets the quantity of a product currently in the shopper's cart.
      Parameters:
      index - zero-based product position
      Returns:
      selected units, or zero for an invalid position

    • getCartProducts

      public SalableProduct[] getCartProducts()
      Returns the products tracked by the shopping cart. The array is copied to protect the original cart structure.
      Returns:
      an array containing the cart product references

    • getCartQuantities

      public int[] getCartQuantities()
      Returns the quantity selected for each product. Each quantity matches the product at the same array index. A quantity of zero means the product is not in the cart.
      Returns:
      an array containing all cart quantities

    • hasItems

      public boolean hasItems()
      Checks whether any selected product is in the cart.
      Returns:
      true when the cart contains at least one product

    • getTotal

      public double getTotal()
      Computes the price of all selected quantities.
      Returns:
      total price of the products currently in the cart

    • displayCart

      public void displayCart()
      Displays cart contents using the same item numbers as the inventory.

    • emptyCart

      public void emptyCart()
      Empties the shopping cart by resetting all selected quantities. Inventory restoration is handled by the StoreFront class.
